title: Airline 24-hour reservation rule
facts: For airline tickets purchased at least seven days before scheduled departure, U.S. rules generally require covered airlines to either allow a reservation to be held at the quoted fare for 24 hours without payment or allow cancellation within 24 hours without penalty.
An airline is not required to offer both the hold option and the penalty-free cancellation option.
The federal 24-hour rule applies to airlines under DOT jurisdiction and does not necessarily apply in the same way to tickets purchased through third-party travel agencies.
